name: NaviTree HTML Sitemap
author: naziraljiwala11

sections.description:
The NaviTree HTML Sitemap plugin allows you to easily display a sitemap of your website’s content. It supports custom post types, hierarchical displays, and various layout options.

Features:
* Multiple Layouts: Choose from Simple List, Grid, Accordion, or Tree/Hierarchy view.
* Custom Post Types: Select which post types to include in your sitemap.
* Structuring: Options to prioritize the “Home” page at the top of the tree.
* Styling: Customize colors, fonts, and borders directly from the settings page.
* Searchable: Includes a live search filter for quick navigation.
* Cache: Built-in caching for performance optimization.
* Shortcode & Block: Use [navitree_html_sitemap] shortcode or the dedicated Gutenberg block.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/navitree-html-sitemap directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Settings->NaviTree HTML Sitemap screen to configure the plugin.
  4. Add the shortcode [navitree_html_sitemap] to any page or post.

screenshots.caption: Admin Settings - The admin settings panel to easily configure the plugin and customize styles.
Tree/Hierarchical View - Displays the pages in a clean, hierarchical tree structure.
Simple List View - A straightforward, clean list view of your sitemap pages.
Grid View - The sitemap displayed in a structured, responsive grid layout.
Accordion View - An interactive accordion layout to keep your sitemap compact and organized.
